function.name: bash_tool
function.description: Run commands in a bash shell. Can execute multiple commands separated by ';' or '&&' or '||'.

function.name: view
function.description: Read the contents of a file or list the contents of a directory. Supports viewing text files with line numbers and optional range selection. For directories, lists files and directories up to 2 levels deep, ignoring hidden items (starting with .) and node_modules. Binary files are detected and rejected.

path.description: Absolute path to the file or directory

view_range.description: Optional line range to view for text files, specified as [start_line, end_line]. Lines are indexed starting at 1. Use -1 as end_line to read to the end of the file.

function.name: create_file
function.description: Create a new file with the specified content. If the file already exists, it will be overwritten. Parent directories will be created automatically if they don't exist.

path.description: The absolute path where the file should be created

file_text.description: The content to write to the file

function.name: str_replace
function.description: Replace a unique string in a file with another string. The string to replace must appear exactly once in the file to prevent unintended changes. Use an empty string as new_str to delete the old string.

old_str.description: The string to replace. Must appear exactly once in the file.

new_str.description: The string to replace it with. Defaults to empty string to delete.
